subject: Request: one-time additional pilot credits + 30-day window — Novus Health
messages:
From: Sofia Marino <sofia.marino@novushealth.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot runway and extra credits request

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team ran a small overnight load and the initial results look promising; we attached a quick usage snapshot (novus-eval-stats.csv). We're very much interested in extending the pilot to include the clinician notes ingestion workload, but we're approaching our PLG credit ceiling this week.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood grant an additional 200k token credits for the pilot (one-time)?
- Can we extend the sandbox window by 30 days to complete the ingestion & eval?

Procurement is looping me in on potential PO timing but they prefer to see this last run before committing. Appreciate a quick yes/no so we can coordinate schedules.

Best,
Sofia Marino
Director of Data Science
Novus Health

Attachments: novus-eval-stats.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marino <sofia.marino@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway and extra credits request

Thanks for the context, Sofia —

This is achievable, but this request requires a one-off approval because it exceeds our standard PLG pilot limits. I want to be transparent about two constraints:
1) We can provide the 200k extra tokens as a one-time grant for the Novus pilot, conditional on a mutual action plan and the ingestion snapshot being completed within the 30-day extension.
2) For commercial governance we need Deal Desk and a senior sign-off (Aditya usually handles credit exceptions; Jordan will run sequencing).

Jordan / Aditya — can you review the attached usage snapshot and confirm we can commit the extra tokens + 30-day sandbox extension? If approved, please escalate to Markus for exec consent (copy a quick one-line approval plus any suggested commercial terms).

Sofia / Procurement — I attached a SOW draft to capture the ingestion scope and timelines; if you can confirm acceptance of those timelines we can accelerate the approval flow.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: novus-sow-draft.pdf (PDF, 46KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot runway and extra credits request — recommend approval

Markus — forwarding a request from Novus Health for a one-time +200k token credit boost and a 30-day sandbox extension. Quick summary:
- Account: Novus Health (targeting clinician notes ingest & RAG evaluation)
- Current ask: +200k tokens one-time; sandbox +30 days
- Rationale: Engineering showed promising early results; extension likely converts to PO within 6 weeks per procurement.
- Attachments: usage snapshot and SOW draft (attached in original).

My recommendation: approve the one-time credit and extension with two guardrails:
1) Credit applied only to the named sandbox project (Novus-ingest) and expires at extension end; not transferrable.
2) Require a mutual action plan sign-off within 72 hours after approval; if the MAP isn't signed, credits are rescinded.

Estimated revenue uplift if converted: $85k ARR in year 1; minimal downside.

If you approve, please reply with a one-line executive consent and any notes for Legal/Finance on the SOW.

Thanks —
Aditya
Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Sofia Marino <sofia.marino@novushealth.ai>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway and extra credits request — approved with conditions

Aditya / Hannah — thanks for the concise summary. Approved.

Executive consent (one-line): Approve one-time 200k token credit and 30-day sandbox extension for Novus Health; apply guardrails below.

Conditions (to be implemented by Deal Desk / CS):
- Credit grant: 200,000 tokens applied to project ID "Novus-ingest" only; expires 2026-06-27 23:59 PT.
- Mutual action plan (MAP): must be signed by Novus and Redwood within 72 hours of this email. If not signed, credits revoked.
- Usage cap & alerts: set automated alert at 75% consumption and a hard cap at 100% to prevent overrun.
- Finance: no invoice adjustments; this is a gratis credit. Legal to review SOW addendum for the extension clause.

Jordan — please action the MAP and configure the billing record per above. Hannah — loop procurement on the MAP and confirm timelines.

Markus Klein
VP Revenue | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
